precip.name: Growing Season Rainfall
precip.description: Total precipitation from April to September. Deficits below 450mm stress vegetative growth; extreme flooding above 900mm waterlogs roots.

heat_days.name: Summer Heat Days (>30°C)
heat_days.description: Days exceeding 30°C in July & August. Above 18 days, thermal stress disrupts corn silking and kernel formation.

tavg.name: Mean Summer Temperature
tavg.description: Average June–August 24h temperature. Nighttime heat accelerates plant respiration and reduces carbohydrate storage.

soc.name: Soil Organic Carbon (0-5cm)
soc.description: Higher organic matter increases soil water-holding capacity, buffering crops against dry spells and drought.

nitrogen.name: Soil Total Nitrogen (0-5cm)
nitrogen.description: Native soil nitrogen provides baseline nutrient supply for early canopy expansion before supplemental fertilizer uptake.

ph.name: Soil pH (H2O)
ph.description: Nutrient bioavailability peaks near pH 6.2–6.8. Acidic soils (<5.5) or strongly alkaline soils (>7.8) induce micronutrient toxicities or lockups.
